item.title: Full Count: ‘Robot umpires’ will save baseball
item.description: Major League Baseball announced the automated ball-strike challenge system last September, commonly referred to as “robot umpires,” which will be used in all MLB regular season and postseason games.

item.title: First Touch: Every MLS team’s 2026 outlook in one sentence
item.description: As the grass thaws and the field is repainted, the 31st Major League Soccer season has started, and with it so has the quest for the MLS Cup — one of the most competitive titles among domestic soccer leagues worldwide. Here's every team's offseason described in one sentence.

item.title: Boston interactive art museum appears on USA TODAY’s award-winning list
item.description: In a city chock-full of historic sites and world-renowned museums — from the Freedom Trail to the Museum of Fine Arts Boston — one museum in particular is shattering norms with an interactive, sensory-filled experience. Endless mirrors and colors combined with visitor-created artwork provides the foundation for the WNDR Museum, which opened its Boston location in February 2024.

item.description: In one corner of TikTok, young men analyze jawlines, discuss the best cosmetic surgeries and give “sub-five normies” advice on how to “ascend” and improve their sexual market value to become a “Chad.”
